usedFor: Google Slides builds decks from a template: “Create Presentation from template” copies it and fills the {{tag}} placeholders.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create Presentation from template” in Google Slides
bestTemplate.why: A new meeting can produce a ready deck with its placeholders filled from the run.

watchOut: “Create Presentation from template” replaces {{tag}} placeholders, so check the template uses tags that match your values.
